args.summary: Commit 55029bc added a score band to fct_loan_balance_daily. It joined stg_bureau on borrower_id with s.ds <= d.ds, so each loan got one row per weekly bureau snapshot. That broke the unique test assert_balance_daily_unique, made dbt_build fail for 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-27, skipped mart_delinquency and blocked publish (so the freshness alert fired). I fixed the model forward in commit caa5cdc so it only uses each borrower's latest snapshot on or before each day. Then I rebuilt and published both partitions. Each day now has one row per loan, and mart_delinquency is current through 2026-10-27. The payments volume alert was expected: Keel re-sent events after a connector restart, which the contract allows. Staging removes the duplicates and fct_payments has 290 unique payments, so I closed it as expected.
